name: Microsoft Teams
description: Microsoft Teams combines chat, video meetings, and file collaboration, tightly integrated with Microsoft 365.
best_for: Segmented by Microsoft into small/medium business, enterprise, education, and individual use — organizations already invested in the Microsoft ecosystem.
features: Chat and channels integrating Loop, OneNote, and third-party apps
AI-powered meetings with real-time translation and insights
Copilot integration for meetings and workflows

alternatives.name: Slack
alternatives.description: A workplace communication platform built around channels, direct messages, integrations, and searchable conversations.
alternatives.best_for: Teams that want a lighter, integration-friendly chat tool

alternatives.name: Discord
alternatives.description: A community-focused communication platform with text channels, voice rooms, and real-time collaboration.
alternatives.best_for: Informal teams and communities that value voice chat

alternatives.name: Mattermost
alternatives.description: A team messaging platform designed for organizations that need greater control over hosting and security.
alternatives.best_for: Technical teams that need self-hosted, secure messaging
